tasks.title: Move repo-owned global skills into their repos
tasks.description:
Problem

Role and product skills load in every chat on this server. They belong to one repo each.

Decision

Move each into its owner repo. Remove the global link.

Fix

  1. Map each skill to its owner repo.

  2. Move the skill folder there.

  3. Remove the global link and the company-skills plugin.

Risk

A session outside the repo loses the skill. That is intended.

Done when

  • The audit rerun shows none of these items.

  • Proof is on this ticket.
